**In one line**: Major AI firms are turning to Singapore as an Asian launchpad for moving models out of the lab and into real-world industrial use, the South China Morning Post reports.

### Key points
- Singapore is emerging as a deployment hub where research-stage AI models are converted into enterprise and industrial tools.
- A stable regulatory climate, data-center infrastructure, and access to Asian markets are cited as the main draws.
- Its geopolitically neutral position between the US and China reportedly acts as a buffer for multinational AI expansion.

### Why it matters
The shift signals that the center of gravity in AI is moving from building bigger models to deploying ones that actually get used. Where Asia's AI commercialization base settles will shape the enterprise AI market in the years ahead.
